# Steve Kinney

> > Teaching resources on TypeScript, React, AI development, and enterprise frontend architecture from Frontend Masters instructor Steve Kinney.

Steve Kinney is a teacher, software engineer at Temporal, and Frontend Masters instructor. This site features comprehensive courses, articles, and tutorials covering modern web development, AI-assisted coding, type safety, testing, and design systems.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript
- React
- AI Development (Cursor, OpenAI, Anthropic)
- Temporal Workflows
- Frontend Masters Courses
- Type Safety & Validation
- Prompt Engineering
- Design Systems & Storybook
- Testing with Vitest
- Enterprise UI Architecture
- Monorepos & Microfrontends
- Developer Tools (VS Code, Figma)
- Neural Networks & AI Fundamentals
- Tailwind CSS
- Express & Full-Stack TypeScript

## AI Development & Prompt Engineering

- [Developing with AI Tools](https://stevekinney.com/courses/ai-development): Using Cursor and Claude Code with Model Context Protocol for AI-assisted dev
- [Prompt Engineering Across the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs](https://stevekinney.com/writing/prompt-engineering-frontier-llms): Cross-provider prompt engineering guide for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini
- [Using Anthropic's Message Batches API with Temporal](https://stevekinney.com/writing/anthropic-batch-api-with-temporal): Async batch processing with Anthropic's API and Temporal workflows
- [AI Fundamentals with Python](https://stevekinney.com/courses/python-ai): NLP and image generation with Python and Hugging Face Transformers
- [Mastering Context Management in Cursor](https://stevekinney.com/courses/ai-development/cursor-context): Cursor's @ symbol system for intent and state context in AI coding
- [Neural Networks](https://stevekinney.com/writing/neural-networks): Beginner-friendly intro to neural networks for software engineers

## TypeScript & Type Safety

- [Full Stack TypeScript](https://stevekinney.com/courses/full-stack-typescript): End-to-end type safety with Zod, React Hook Form, tRPC, and Express
- [React with TypeScript](https://stevekinney.com/courses/react-typescript): Frontend Masters workshop on type-safe React 19 with TypeScript patterns
- [Type-Safe Database Access with Prisma](https://stevekinney.com/courses/full-stack-typescript/typesafe-database-with-prisma): Prisma setup with Express and TypeScript for end-to-end type safety
- [Advanced Validation Techniques in Express with TypeScript](https://stevekinney.com/courses/full-stack-typescript/class-validator-class-transformer-express): Object-oriented validation with class-validator and class-transformer
- [Adding Types to Express Responses](https://stevekinney.com/courses/full-stack-typescript/adding-types-to-express-responses): Type-safe Express response patterns for success and error handling

## Enterprise Frontend & Architecture

- [Server Components and Streaming SSR](https://stevekinney.com/courses/enterprise-ui/server-components-and-streaming): React Server Components, client boundaries, and Suspense streaming explained
- [Monoliths, Microfrontends, Monorepos, and the Real Tradeoffs](https://stevekinney.com/courses/enterprise-ui/monoliths-microfrontends-and-monorepos): Runtime vs repository topology tradeoffs in frontend architecture
- [Authentication, Authorization, and Multi-Tenancy](https://stevekinney.com/courses/enterprise-ui/authentication-and-authorization): OIDC, SAML, OAuth 2.0, and multi-tenant patterns for enterprise frontends
- [Dependency Management in Monorepos](https://stevekinney.com/courses/enterprise-ui/dependency-management): Version drift, phantom dependencies, and workspace patterns with pnpm
- [Image & Asset Optimization for React](https://stevekinney.com/courses/react-performance/image-and-asset-optimization): WebP/AVIF formats, lazy loading, and responsive images for React apps

## Testing & Quality Assurance

- [Dependency Injection In JavaScript: What, Why, And How](https://stevekinney.com/courses/testing/dependency-injection): JavaScript dependency injection patterns for testability with Vitest
- [Strategies For Testing Conditional Logic](https://stevekinney.com/courses/testing/strategies-for-testing-conditional-logic): Branch coverage and edge case testing strategies with Vitest
- [Why You Don't Need 100% Code Coverage](https://stevekinney.com/courses/testing/you-dont-need-perfect-code-coverage): Code coverage as a tool, not a goal: testing philosophy and best practices
- [Setting Up GitHub Actions to Run Vitest Unit Tests](https://stevekinney.com/courses/testing/continuous-integration): GitHub Actions CI workflow setup for automated Vitest testing
- [Accessibility Testing in Storybook](https://stevekinney.com/courses/storybook/accessibility-testing): A11y audits with @storybook/addon-a11y, axe-core, and Playwright integration
- [Clearing, Restoring, and Resetting Mocks](https://stevekinney.com/courses/testing/clearing-restoring-and-resetting-mocks): Mock lifecycle management and cleanup strategies in Vitest

## Developer Tools & Workflows

- [Visual Studio Code](https://stevekinney.com/courses/visual-studio-code): Comprehensive VS Code guide covering debugging, Dev Containers, and snippets
- [Figma for Developers](https://stevekinney.com/courses/figma): Frontend Masters course on Figma Dev Mode and design-dev collaboration
